reason: Document A wins the trust of sales-minded board members by honestly confronting the year-one cash flow gap (since membership ramps up gradually while ad revenue stops immediately) and building a buffer into the target for churn, whereas Document B glosses over the cash shortfall and relies on an unaccounting 875-member target. However, the margin is only slight because Document A misstates the ad revenue drop as happening over two years instead of one, while Document B gets that timeline right.
